norms.newUnder30Days: New tokens often have fewer than 2,000 holders and concentrated allocations. Verified vesting contracts are not creator holdings.
norms.taxes: A sell tax above 20% is a trap; ordinary fees are usually below 5%.
norms.liquidity: An unlocked pool is a risk signal only with control or removal evidence. A long-unmoved old pool is not itself a rug.
norms.sells: A few failed sells alongside hundreds of successful sells are network noise. Repeated failed sells when buys work and almost no sell succeeds are the reliable honeypot signal.

context.caveat: All token names, tickers, contracts, pools and histories are invented. This is a screening exercise, not investment advice.
